content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom operator billing and OSS software and services; no network security products or customers in common."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Banknote validators, payment and authentication technology for cash handling; a different business from network security."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"IoT cellular routers and device management for OEMs and utilities; networking hardware overlaps, but not enterprise security."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Utility smart meters, filtration and aerospace components; industrial and defense manufacturing, not network security."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise storage arrays and data management; same enterprise buyers and channels, but storage rather than security."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Government engineering and program-management services for defense and infrastructure; a services contractor, not a product security vendor."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Mailing equipment, postage and parcel shipping services; a physical mailing business with no security product overlap."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Vehicle and asset telematics hardware with fleet software subscriptions; different customers and product category."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Application development, data integration and monitoring software; enterprise IT software, not security hardware or subscriptions."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Cash-in-transit, ATM services and armored transport; physical cash logistics rather than network security."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges and metal castings made in owned plants; industrial hardware manufacturing with no network security offering."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Cloud work management and content software for enterprises and government; SaaS productivity, not network security."}]}
